Implemented and privately pushed through 9bf2729 (now 7f6324a). (Exact-head CI passes), including Python3.12/3.13, clean wheels and WASM.

Delivered:

  • Offline llms.txt, generated API reference, source-derived capability catalog and CLI.
  • Public gradient/pullback validation utilities, Hypothesis tests, actionable adapter errors.
  • Contributor routing, checked documentation examples and CI documentation consistency.
  • Fixed the sphere/cylinder global-polarization-default bug, with regressions.

Verification: 84 Rust tests,2072 Python tests, lint/types/formatting and clean-wheel checks. Targeted affected workloads remain 7.20× /1.56× faster than upstream; historical full-grid results retain their original hashes.

Browser branch handoff also complete: host gates pass, and the three agreed catalog/docs files now describe the narrow WASM geometry objective accurately. Generic WASM pullbacks remain unsupported. Root owns browser commits and deployment; no PRs/comments changed.
